description: Phase 3 sweep S3 (Comparison Protocol step F): training-set size 25-2000 windows and full, for the paper HEA QSTL, the context-preserving QSTL (orders 1 and 3) and the classical baselines B0-B4, on raw and MA5 moves, AAPL and GOOGL. Evaluation matrix: no winner selected.

evaluation.split: test = chronological last 20 % of T+1 windows (never subsampled); training = contiguous block of train_size windows drawn inside the training split with the run seed
evaluation.checkpoint: final epoch for quantum models; validation-selected refit for baselines
evaluation.aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over seeds; paired-by-seed differences with a 95 % t interval
evaluation.tie_rule: a paired difference whose 95 % interval contains 0 is reported as not distinguishable
evaluation.selection_rule: none: evaluation matrix; comparisons follow LOG.md Comparison Protocol
